description: This file contains utility functions and classes for manipulating and comparing computational graphs in PyTorch's FX framework, including a HolderModule class, a function to lift subgraphs as modules, and a graph comparison function.

classes.name: HolderModule
classes.description: A module that copies all attributes from a given dictionary to submodules, used for subgraph lifting.

methods.name: lift_subgraph_as_module
methods.description: Creates a GraphModule from a subgraph, copying necessary attributes from the parent module, and returns the new module along with a mapping of original to new attribute names.

methods.name: compare_graphs
methods.description: Compares two graphs for structural and connectivity equality, returning True if they are identical.
